findings.evidence: robots.txt disallows all paths for: GPTBot.
findings.mechanism: Assistants that fetch pages live identify with these user agents. A blanket disallow for them means no page on the site can ever be retrieved or cited, however good the content is. The site stays fully visible to humans, which is why this is usually unnoticed.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Pages become eligible for retrieval and citation by assistants that honour these agents.
steps: Open robots.txt and locate the user-agent groups: GPTBot.
If citation in AI assistants is wanted, remove the `Disallow: /` line from those groups, or narrow it to the paths that genuinely must stay private.
Keep the exclusion only where it is a considered licensing decision rather than a copied default.
Leave authenticated, checkout and account paths disallowed for every agent.
suggested_action.summary: Decide deliberately which AI crawlers may read the site, and remove the blanket disallow for any you want citations from.
suggested_action.verification: Re-run the audit; ACC-AI-CRAWLER-BLOCKED should no longer fire.

findings.title: robots.txt blocks AI assistant crawlers

findings.mechanism: Without a sitemap, discovery depends entirely on internal linking. Pages that are not linked from a crawled page are never found, so deep and newer content is disproportionately missed.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Complete URL discovery without relying on link depth.
steps: Generate sitemap.xml covering every canonical, indexable URL.
Set lastmod from real content-change dates, not build time.
Add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.
suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap with accurate lastmod values and reference it from robots.txt.
suggested_action.verification: Re-run the audit; sitemap.url_count is non-zero.

findings.title: No usable XML sitemap found

findings.mechanism: Without a canonical, parameter and slash variants of the same page compete as separate documents, splitting the signals that would otherwise accumulate on one authoritative URL.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Duplicate variants consolidate onto one URL.
steps: Emit <link rel="canonical"> with the absolute preferred URL on every template.
Ensure the canonical matches the sitemap entry.
suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referencing canonical link to every page.
suggested_action.verification: Re-run the audit; canonical coverage above 50%.
